title: chaindora scan summary
description: Terminal record of a scan run. Emitted alongside findings so receivers can tell whether a run completed cleanly. Without this, a scan that crashed midway looks identical to a clean scan that happened to find fewer packages — and the receiver would silently demote the missing packages from 'installed' to 'uninstalled'. Borrowed conceptually from bumblebee's scan_summary record.

status.description: Terminal state. 'complete' = run finished, findings are the full result, receivers may promote to current state. 'partial' = ran but ended early (timeout, partial detector failure, interrupted); findings are real but inventory is incomplete, do NOT promote to current state. 'error' = failed before completion; findings best-effort, keep previous current state.

finding_count.description: len(findings) at exit. Receivers can compare to actual payload length as a sanity check.

command.description: argv the user ran, for audit trail. Best-effort.

chdora_version.description: Binary version. Useful when fleet aggregates show divergent results across agent versions.

error_message.description: When status != complete, brief failure cause. Free-form.
